proposedHelperLines: export function sourceNativeFunctionIdentityMatchesV1(source: unknown, native: unknown): boolean {
if (!source || !native || typeof source !== 'object' || typeof native !== 'object' || Array.isArray(source) || Array.isArray(native)) return false;
const s = source as Record<string, unknown>, n = native as Record<string, unknown>;
if (s.sha256 !== n.sha256 || s.version !== n.version || typeof n.sha256 !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(n.sha256)) return false;
if (typeof n.ea !== 'number' || !Number.isSafeInteger(n.ea) || Object.is(n.ea, -0) || n.ea < 0 || n.ea > 0xffffffff) return false;
try { const parsed = validateIdentity(s); return BigInt(parsed.ea) === BigInt(n.ea); } catch { return false; }
